description: pigma.org: natural hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pigma.org. Coverage: the area served by pigma.org. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about natural hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Lot-et-Garonne : Réseaux des pistes forestières de DFCI (Défense des F; Instruction technique : Plans de protection des forêts contre les ince; S/P par commune au titre des mouvements de terrain des sols sur la pér; Nombre de reconnaissances Cat Nat par commune au titre des mouvements . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
